ينتهكان (form VIII)
# يَنْتَهِكَانِ (yantahikāni) /jan.ta.hi.kaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
# يُنْتَهَكَانِ (yuntahakāni) /jun.ta.ha.kaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
